seasons.review_body: I Will Find You premieres on Netflix on June 18, 2026 - two days from the time of this entry. BollyAI will update this with grounded critical reception once the series is live and reviews are published. The limited series stars Sam Worthington as a father jailed for his son's apparent murder who receives evidence the boy may be alive, and escapes to follow that thread. Based on Harlan Coben's 2023 novel, it is the first of Coben's works adapted into an American setting for Netflix.
